description: Rewrite commit history. Use action=reword|squash|rewrite-messages|backup|restore. History rewriting changes commit hashes and requires force-push; create a backup first.

messages.description: Map of commit SHA to replacement message (rewrite-messages).

ref.description: Commit ref to reword (defaults to HEAD).

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the local Git repository. If omitted, falls back to the server default set via the GIT_REPO_PATH environment variable or --repo-path CLI argument.

name: git_rewrite
title: Git History Rewrite
